title: Investigating the Role of Model-Based Learning in Exploration and Transfer

layout.note: Three columns divided by thin grey vertical rules: the model diagram (a) on the left, pre-training (b) above fine-tuning (c) in the middle, and fine-tuning (d) with a colour key on the right; each right-hand panel is a stack of white rows of cells with a reward arrow to an environment thumbnail.

lesson: Show an ablation design as rows of the same component cells redrawn once per condition, with a two-colour outline code (navy = from model-based, pink = from model-free) and grey for re-initialised blocks, so the reader can read off which parts each experiment carries over.
